description: Synthetic structural analogue of the reported IEC61508-0 4.9 case; not a standard excerpt.
faq: Further information and frequently asked questions are available in Annex A.
reading:
You may find it helpful to read the following sections first:

- Annex A of IEC 61508-5 gives background for this synthetic example.
- Figure 2 and Table 1 of IEC 61508-1 illustrate the example; Clause 7 of IEC 61508-1 contains related material.
- Clauses 6 and 8 of IEC 61508-1 contain requirements discussed in the example.
- Annex A of IEC 61508-6 contains an overview.
- Figure 2 and Table 1 of IEC 61508-2 and Figure 3 and Table 1 of IEC 61508-3 explain the context of Clause 7 of IEC 61508-2 and IEC 61508-3 respectively.
interpretation: Each requirement should be considered in the context of the example (where applicable), together with its objectives.
